answer: The sky is blue because molecules in the atmosphere scatter shorter blue wavelengths of sunlight more than other colors.

    *   Short wavelengths (blue/violet) scatter more easily than long wavelengths (red/yellow).
    *   This phenomenon is called Rayleigh scattering.
